name: qroz
description: Qroz application framework for humans and coding agents.

scripts.clean: find packages examples -type d -name dist -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
scripts.verify: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run docs:check && npm run agents:check
scripts.inspect: npm run build && node packages/cli/bin/qroz.mjs inspect examples/hello-world/dist/app.js
scripts.inspect:json: npm run build && node packages/cli/bin/qroz.mjs inspect examples/hello-world/dist/app.js --json
scripts.release:verify: npm run verify && npm run pack:check && npm run release:check
